mcq_fix.s: Consider the following pairs: 1. Iqta — Delhi Sultanate 2. Jagir — Mughal Empire 3. Amaram — Vijayanagara Empire 4. Mokasa — Marathas Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
mcq_fix.why: UPSC 2000 key pairs Mokasa with Marathas (ycfe68eef657)

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Sultanate literature / Firoz Tughlaq
wrong topic: Balban's theory of kingship

patterns: Direct 'who introduced' items dominate: iqta = Iltutmish, dagh-huliya = Alauddin, khalisa expansion = Alauddin, hereditary iqtas = Firoz.
APPSC asked the postal system (horse post ulaq bringing Khorasan fruit) - Ibn Battuta's ulaq vs dawa is the trap.
Match-the-term items: Iqta-Sultanate, Jagir-Mughal, Amaram-Vijayanagara, Mokasa-Marathas; Madad-i-Mash = revenue-free grant to learned.
Traps: iqta 'indigenous' (false), Balban branding horses (false), Khalsa/Jagir vs Khalisa/Iqta.
App MCQs lean on multi-statement and chronology formats and minor details (decimal ranks, khwajas) more than the PYQs do.
